title: Gaudí Column Field
description: A fragment-shader companion to the Gaudí column: the same procedural organic fold pattern rendered straight on the pixel plane, in stone tones. Two extra misgeneration modes push it further — Moiré interference beats a high-frequency grid against itself into shimmering pink fringes, and Edge warping pinches and tears the field near its borders with hard high-contrast overfitted rings, like a neural net hallucinating detail at the edges. Mode, speed and fold scale are live; the beat nudges the speed.
